  1. QRT-5
  2. QRT-6

All products display the same incorrect dog image

Done
Description

Environment: SauceDemo – Chrome browser

Test Account: problem_user

Precondition: User is logged in successfully.

Steps to Reproduce:

  1. Open SauceDemo.

  2. Log in using problem_user and secret_sauce.

  3. Navigate to the Products page.

  4. Inspect all six product images.

Expected Result:
Each product should display its corresponding product image.

Actual Result:
All six products display the same incorrect image of a dog holding a ball.

Severity: Medium (provisional)

Evidence: Screenshot of all six product cards.
